grants.description: Research grants for Islamic and Arabic archaeology, history, geography, art history, epigraphy, religion and literature, with priority on the period from the beginning of Islam to the Ottoman era.

grants.name: Getty Residential Grants (Getty Villa and Conservation Guest Scholars)
grants.deadlineNote: Usually closes 1 October for residencies the following academic year. The Getty Research Institute Scholars Program and pre/postdoctoral fellowships are paused for 2027-28 during the Getty Center closure; Villa and Conservation Institute grants continue.
grants.region: Open to scholars of any nationality or place of residence
grants.amount: Villa scholars receive a stipend (about USD 21,500 for three months), housing and travel support
grants.description: Residential grants in Los Angeles for research on the ancient Mediterranean world (Getty Villa) and for conservation professionals and scholars (Getty Conservation Institute).

grants.name: STIAS Individual and Team Fellowships
grants.deadlineNote: Second-semester 2028 call opens 1 January 2027 and closes 30 April 2027; first-semester calls open 1 July and close 31 October.
grants.region: International; scholars from Africa and the Global South welcomed
grants.amount: Residential fellowship with accommodation, travel and living support
grants.description: Residential fellowships of one semester at STIAS in South Africa for scholars in any discipline, including the humanities, to work on an original research project. Team projects of two to five researchers are also accepted.

grants.name: Swedish Collegium for Advanced Study Fellowships
grants.deadlineNote: Calls usually announced in late February or early March; deadlines usually late May or early June for the following academic year.
grants.amount: Residential fellowship with salary or stipend and housing in Uppsala
grants.description: Residential fellowships in Uppsala for a semester or academic year, mainly in the humanities and social sciences. Programmes include the General Fellowship Programme and the Human Past programme for archaeology and history.

grants.name: Houghton Library Visiting Fellowships
grants.deadlineNote: Applications for 2027-28 due 15 January 2027.
grants.region: Open to all nationalities (J-1 visa sponsored by Harvard)
grants.amount: USD 4,500 stipend
grants.description: Short research fellowships at Harvard's rare book and manuscript library for scholars at any career stage whose projects need its collections, including literature, theatre, dance, music and early modern history. Applicants must list relevant Houghton holdings.

grants.name: MacDowell Fellowship
grants.deadlineNote: Fall-Winter 2027-28: applications open 19 January 2027, close 10 February 2027. Spring-Summer 2028: open 17 August 2027, close 10 September 2027.
grants.region: Open to artists of any nationality; conversational English needed
grants.amount: Residency with studio, room and board at no cost; need-based stipends and travel grants available
grants.description: Residencies of up to several weeks in New Hampshire for artists in architecture, film and video, interdisciplinary arts, literature, music composition, theatre and visual arts.

grants.name: Yaddo Artist Residencies
grants.deadlineNote: Winter cycle portal opens 20 November and closes 20 December 2026 (or earlier if 1,600 applications are reached); summer cycle 1 June to 1 July.
grants.region: International artists accepted; students enrolled in degree programmes are not eligible
grants.amount: Residency with room, board and studio at no cost
grants.description: Residencies of two to six weeks in Saratoga Springs, New York, for artists working in literature, visual arts, music composition, film, performance and related forms who are creating new work.

grants.name: Royal Numismatic Society Research Grants
grants.deadlineNote: Two rounds a year: 28 February and 31 August, using the standard online form.
grants.region: Open to Fellows and non-Fellows; no nationality restriction stated
grants.amount: Usually under GBP 1,000; larger grants considered
grants.description: Small grants from named funds for numismatic research, including the Neil Kreitman Central Asian Numismatic Endowment and the Nicholas Lowick Memorial Fund for Oriental (Asian and Islamic) numismatics. Students may apply for defined research projects but not course fees.

grants.name: Delfina Foundation Residency for Artists Based in India
grants.funder: Delfina Foundation with Charles Wallace India Trust and Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation
grants.deadlineNote: The 2026 call (for the January to March 2027 residency) closed on 5 April 2026; the call is usually issued in early spring.
grants.region: Indian nationals domiciled in India, under 40, without a CWIT grant in the last five years or a previous Inlaks overseas award
grants.amount: Return flight, GBP 40 per day living allowance, GBP 1,200 materials budget and housing in London
grants.description: Twelve-week residency in London for contemporary visual artists from India, with studio visits, mentoring and a programme of museum and gallery visits.

grants.name: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships
grants.funder: Harry Ransom Center, University of Texas at Austin
grants.deadlineNote: The 2027-28 round closed on 6 November 2026; the call usually closes in early November each year.
grants.region: International applicants eligible, with extra support for international fellows
grants.amount: USD 3,500 per month for postdoctoral fellows; USD 2,500 dissertation and USD 2,000 travel stipends; extra USD 500 for international fellows
grants.description: One- or two-month fellowships and travel stipends for research in the Ransom Center's collections of literature, film, photography, performing arts and art.

grants.name: Smithsonian Institution Fellowship Program
grants.deadlineNote: The 2027 cycle closed on 15 October 2026; the deadline is usually mid-October.
grants.region: Open to US and non-US applicants
grants.amount: Stipends for predoctoral, postdoctoral and senior fellows
grants.description: Residential fellowships at Smithsonian museums and research centres in Washington, DC, for graduate students, postdocs and senior scholars, including art history, anthropology, history and material culture.

grants.name: Bibliographical Society Major and Minor Grants (incl. Pantzer Fellowship)
grants.deadlineNote: Major Grants, Pantzer Scholarship and Pantzer Fellowship due 15 January 2027 (23:59 GMT); Minor Grants and conference subventions accepted at any time.
grants.region: Scholars of all nationalities; membership and institutional affiliation not required
grants.amount: Major grants and Pantzer Fellowship up to about GBP 4,000; minor grants smaller
grants.description: Grants for bibliographical research on the physical book or manuscript as historical evidence, including book history, textual transmission, printing, publishing and bookbinding. Doctoral students may apply for Major and Minor Grants and the Pantzer Scholarship.

grants.name: Israel Institute for Advanced Studies Individual Fellowships and Research Groups
grants.funder: Israel Institute for Advanced Studies (IIAS), Hebrew University of Jerusalem
grants.deadlineNote: Calls for 2028-29 close 1 December 2026 (midnight).
grants.region: Scholars from Israel and abroad; individual fellows must hold a tenured academic post
grants.amount: Fellowship stipend and subsidised accommodation for fellows from abroad
grants.description: Residential fellowships in Jerusalem for individual scholars or for research groups proposed by an initiator, in any field including the humanities. Group residencies are usually five or ten months.

grants.name: Stanford Humanities Center Fellowships for External Faculty
grants.deadlineNote: Applications for 2027-28 closed on 1 October 2026; the next cycle opens in August with a 1 October deadline.
grants.region: No citizenship requirement; junior faculty 3 to 10 years past PhD and senior faculty
grants.amount: Up to about USD 70,000 plus a housing and moving allowance
grants.description: One-year residential fellowships at Stanford for humanities and interpretive social science scholars. Creative arts projects are not eligible, and the fellowship is offered once only.

grants.name: Sundance Institute Documentary Fund
grants.deadlineNote: Periodic open calls; the last ran 18 May to 15 June 2026 and the next is to be announced in early 2027.
grants.amount: Grants for development, production and post-production
grants.description: Grants for feature-length documentary films (52 minutes or longer) by independent filmmakers, with proposals in English and budgets in US dollars.

grants.name: Chiang Ching-kuo Foundation Research Grants (Asia-Pacific)
grants.funder: Chiang Ching-kuo Foundation for International Scholarly Exchange
grants.deadlineNote: Applications accepted 1 August to 15 October each year.
grants.region: Scholars at academic institutions; regional committees decide eligibility, so check which region covers India
grants.amount: Up to USD 120,000 over three years
grants.description: Research grants for Chinese studies in the humanities and social sciences, with priority for collaborative projects with institutions in Taiwan. The Foundation also offers lecture series and conference grants with the same October deadline.

grants.name: Aga Khan Program for Islamic Architecture Postdoctoral Fellowship
grants.funder: Aga Khan Program for Islamic Architecture, MIT
grants.deadlineNote: Requirements are published in November each year; the deadline is usually in February.
grants.region: International; PhD holders or practitioners with at least three years of experience
grants.amount: Stipend, MIT library access and email
grants.description: Postdoctoral or post-professional fellowship at MIT for research on Islamic architecture, urbanism, landscape and conservation.

grants.name: Berggruen Prize Essay Competition
grants.deadlineNote: Annual; the 2026 competition closed on 17 August 2026. Calls usually open in spring with a summer deadline.
grants.region: Open worldwide; essays in English or Chinese
grants.amount: Cash prize in each language track (see current call)
grants.description: Annual essay competition on a set philosophical theme (2026: 'A New Axial Age?'), open to anyone writing in English or Chinese.

grants.name: Endangered Material Knowledge Programme Grants
grants.funder: Endangered Material Knowledge Programme (EMKP), British Museum
grants.deadlineNote: 2026-27 call closes 1 December 2026, 12:00 GMT.
grants.region: Open regardless of nationality; individuals attached to host institutions, communities or institutions
grants.amount: Small Grants and Legacy Digitisation Grants up to GBP 20,000 for one year; larger documentation grants also offered
grants.description: Grants to document endangered material knowledge such as crafts, building practices and making traditions, and to digitise legacy field records (notes, photographs, film, audio). Fieldwork, equipment, travel and community assistants are eligible costs; principal applicants' salaries are not.

grants.name: Inlaks-Asia Art Archive Art Grant
grants.funder: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation and Asia Art Archive
grants.deadlineNote: Applications for 2027 close Monday 30 November 2026.
grants.region: Indian citizens residing in India, born between 1 January 1991 and 1 January 2001; collectives eligible
grants.amount: Up to INR 2,00,000
grants.description: One-year grant (January to December 2027) for artists proposing research-led art-making around the archive as concept, system and medium, including workshops, collaboration and formal experiments.

grants.name: Inlaks Research and Travel Grant
grants.deadlineNote: Annual; the 2026 round has closed (shortlisted applicants were informed in early October). Watch the page for the next call.
grants.region: Indian passport holders residing in India, born on or after 1 January 1991, registered for a PhD with a confirmed synopsis at an Indian university
grants.amount: Travel and living support for up to three months abroad
grants.description: Supports humanities and social science PhD students at Indian universities for short visits to institutions abroad to use archives and libraries and consult experts. Applicants may apply for this or the Inlaks-King's India Institute Studentship in a given year, not both.

grants.name: Inlaks Fine Art Award
grants.deadlineNote: Annual; the 2026 round has closed (interview shortlist announced late October). Watch the page for the next call.
grants.region: Indian citizens residing in India, born on or after 1 January 1996; recent graduates or final-year students of leading Indian visual arts institutes
grants.amount: INR 3,00,000 for one year
grants.description: Award for emerging visual artists to work independently in India for a year, including a four-week art residency in India ending in an open day.

grants.name: Inlaks Theatre Award
grants.deadlineNote: Annual; the 2026 round has closed (interview shortlist announced early September). Watch the page for the next call.
grants.region: Indian citizens residing in India, born on or after 1 January 1991; recent graduates of leading Indian theatre institutes or practitioners without a formal degree
grants.amount: INR 15,000 per month for up to one year
grants.description: Supports emerging theatre practitioners to build skills through training workshops, residencies and similar programmes under a mentor or institution.

grants.name: Inlaks Overseas Art Residencies
grants.deadlineNote: Each residency has its own annual call; 2026-27 calls (Gasworks, ISCP, Skowhegan, Rijksakademie and others) have closed. Watch the opportunities page.
grants.region: Indian passport holders resident in India; age limits vary (often born on or after 1991, or 35 and under); no prior Inlaks overseas grant
grants.amount: Residency costs, travel and living support
grants.description: Funded places for Indian visual artists at residencies abroad, including Gasworks (London), ISCP (New York), Skowhegan (Maine), Rijksakademie (Amsterdam), NIROX (South Africa), UNIDEE (Italy), the International Center of Photography and Delfina Foundation.

grants.name: IDFA Bertha Fund Classic
grants.deadlineNote: Single deadline of 10 February 2027 (entries open late December 2026); the former December and June rounds have been merged.
grants.region: Directors who are nationals of and live in a listed country; India is on the 2026 IBF Classic country list
grants.amount: Grants for project development or production and post-production
grants.description: Grants for creative feature-length documentary projects from Africa, Asia, Latin America, Eastern Europe and other listed regions, at development or production stage. Applications are entered by the director or producer.

grants.name: Hawthornden Writers' Residencies
grants.deadlineNote: Applications for 2028 sessions open on the residencies page in March 2027; 2027 applications have closed.
grants.region: International; creative writers in all genres
grants.amount: Fully funded residency including room and board
grants.description: Month-long residential retreats for published creative writers at Hawthornden Castle (Scotland), Casa Ecco (Lake Como, Italy) and Hawthornden Brooklyn (New York).

grants.name: Akademie Schloss Solitude Fellowship
grants.deadlineNote: The next call is expected in autumn 2027 for fellowships starting no earlier than autumn 2028; the previous round closed in November 2025.
grants.amount: Residential fellowship with monthly stipend and studio-apartment in Stuttgart
grants.description: Residential fellowships in Stuttgart for artists, writers, designers, architects and researchers, selected by an international jury.

grants.name: Clark Library Fellowships
grants.funder: William Andrews Clark Memorial Library and Center for 17th- and 18th-Century Studies, UCLA
grants.deadlineNote: Applications for 2027-28 due 1 February 2027 (11:59 pm Pacific).
grants.region: Short-term and bibliographical fellowships open to international applicants eligible to research in the US; some graduate awards limited to US citizens or students at US universities
grants.amount: Short-term fellowships for one to three months; Clark Bibliographical Fellowship USD 12,000
grants.description: Residential fellowships at UCLA's Clark Library for research on early modern Britain and Europe, the long eighteenth century, Oscar Wilde and the 1890s, fine printing and related collections. A two-year Getty Clark postdoctoral fellowship is also offered.

grants.name: Lewis Walpole Library Visiting Fellowships and Travel Grants
grants.deadlineNote: The 2027-28 round closed on 2 November 2026; applications open each 1 June with an early November deadline.
grants.region: Postdoctoral and advanced scholars and doctoral candidates; non-US citizens eligible (US tax withholding applies)
grants.amount: Four-week visiting fellowships with stipend, travel and housing; shorter travel grants
grants.description: Fellowships for research in the Lewis Walpole Library's collections on eighteenth-century Britain, including prints, drawings, manuscripts and Horace Walpole's library.

grants.name: Persian Heritage Foundation Grants for Academic Research
grants.deadlineNote: Two rounds a year: applications received before 1 April get a response by mid-May; before 1 October, a response later in the year.
grants.region: Open to applicants of any nationality; grantees need a bank account compliant with US banking rules and must follow US OFAC regulations
grants.amount: Individual research grants up to USD 10,000
grants.description: Grants for research on Iranian civilisation and its wider reach, including Central Asia, the Caucasus and the Indian subcontinent; publication and institutional grants are also offered. Tuition, PhD dissertation work and conference travel are not funded.
